leadText: Vinnie Penna, also known as Wayne Grayson, is an American actor, voice actor, and fight director who works for the English-language dub of .
plainText:
Vinnie Penna, also known as Wayne Grayson, is an American actor, voice actor, and fight director who works for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Grayson first began to provide voices in during the fifth season. As with most other voice actors who worked with 4Kids Entertainment, he left when and TAJ Productions took over the dubbing and distribution of the series. Grayson later returned to the starting with Crossing Paths.
